Commentary.Commentary: Taijul Islam was the only Bangladeshi bowler to impress consistently. Overall, the visitors' bowling lacked teeth to trouble the Indian batting. Barring the first session yesterday, India's batsmen were hardly challenged although there were a plethora of chances missed. India became the first team to post 600-plus totals thrice in a row. A huge mountain to climb for Bangladesh, starting with a tricky phase to stumps today. The reply isn't far away.

A marathon batting performance from India comes to an end. Murali Vijay's century and a 83 from Cheteshwar Pujara set the platform that was consolidated further by a brilliant double ton from Virat Kohli. Just like India's no.3 batsman, Ajinkya Rahane too missed out on a century but Wriddhiman Saha didn't. The keeper batsman batted well and Ravindra Jadeja too had some fun with a fifty of his own to complete a ruthless batting performance.
Declaration has finally come. Kohli has called his boys back and now they will have a go at the Bangladeshi batsmen. Jadeja and Saha rush back to the pavilion with a smile on their faces.

Pitch Report - Sunil Gavaskar feels that the pitch was really good to bat yesterday and the Indian batters made full use of it. Also says that the conditions supported the pitch really well. Adds that turn will keep on increasing with every passing day as it will be a really good wicket for spinners. Ends by saying that there are a few cracks which have not opened up which makes it still a good batting wicket.

The Bangladeshi bowlers started well but hardly troubled once Kohli got in and will try to impose pressure on the home side with regular wickets. If they fail to pick up quick wickets, it might just be a really long day on the field for the visitors. Stay tuned for all the live action.

Hello and welcome for the 2nd day of the only Test match between India and Bangladesh. The hosts have totally dominated yesterday's game of play. Apart from KL Rahul, everyone got going. Vijay and Kohli, each scored a ton to keep the scoreboard ticking. While the former got out, the latter has kept on marching alongside Rahane. Those two will look to post a huge score on the board.
....Day 2, Session 1....

The pitch has looked good for batting although there is a two-paced nature to it coupled with slow turn. Still, it's been a fairly good surface to bat on and India's batsmen have cashed in. It won't be wrong to say that most of the dismissals today were a result of the batsmen gifting their wickets. The stage is set for India to really post a gargantuan total on the board. Bangladesh will hope they can somehow limit the damage. Do join us tomorrow at 0930 local, 0400 GMT for the second day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

Bangladesh did have their chances in the first session but failed to grab those and it hurt them badly. The run out chance of Vijay was the biggest blemish for them. Taskin Ahmed and Kamrul Rabbi were impressive early on but lacked fizz as the day progressed. Mehedi Hasan was impressive in parts but overall, Bangladesh's spinners failed to apply constant pressure. There was some discipline in the bowling in the first session but nothing much to write home about after that.

Virat Kohli brought up another brilliant ton and is still there with Ajinkya Rahane who has looked fluent as well. Vijay carried on and is inching closer to another fab Test ton. Virat Kohli has got a start and is timing the ball really well too. Bangladesh's bowlers weren't accurate enough after lunch and have allowed the hosts to dominate proceedings. Unless the visitors make inroads after tea, they could be staring at a massive total. Slider outside off, Vijay gets back and punches it towards cover where it is well stopped.
Flatter outside off, Vijay stays back and cuts it towards point.
Floated around off, Vijay makes room and pushes it to mid off.
Speared down the leg side, Vijay looks to flick but misses.
Fuller on the stumps, defended well off the front foot.
Full and around off, Vijay is pinged on the front pad. Muted appeal but there was a thick inside edge there.
SHAKIB AL HASAN comes into the attack.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara uses his feet and pats it to the bowler.
Loopy on off, reaches out and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, gets well forward and blocks.
On a length outside off, Vijay defends it well from the crease.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
On a length outside off, gets on the back foot and blocks it well.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends solidly.
Fuller on middle and leg, gets across and clips it down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! SMACKED! Short and wide outside off, Vijay gets on top of the bounce and slashes it uppish over point. Brings up the 50-run stand between these two. They just love batting together, don't they?
Good length outside off, stays back and punches it towards mid off.
Good length outside off, Vijay stays back and eases it through cover for a couple.
Fuller around off, Pujara gets across and powers it past the bowler. Gets it past mid on to the deep as the batsmen get three.

FOUR! AND AGAIN! The luck seems to be with the Indians at this point. On a length outside off, Vijay stays back to play it with an open face. The ball goes off the outer half just past first slip to the third man fence. Shakib was a bit late to react and probably a bit too finely placed as well.
Tossed up gently outside off, reaches out and pats it towards short cover.
Floated on middle and leg, worked with the turn through square leg for a single.

FOUR! ANOTHER EDGE GOES SAFE! Fuller outside off, Pujara was playing for the turn but this one skid through off the deck. He pushed hard at it and that caused the outside edge. The ball just flew past the first slip fielder towards third man fence.
Drifting in from around off, uses his feet and nudges it towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, whipped away towards deep mid on for a single.
Good length outside off, stabbed off the back foot towards point.
Fuller ball wide outside off, no shot offered.
Full and around off, gets on the front foot and blocks it well.
FOUR! Thumped! Half-volley outside off, easy pickings but you still need to put these away. Pujara responds with a crunchy drive straight back past the bowler. Beats mid off comfortably to the ropes.
Length ball outside off, gets forward and defends it towards cover.
Good length outside off, Pujara doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Drifting in on middle and leg, gets across and taps it towards short leg.
Fuller on middle and off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
Floated on middle, Vijay steps out and flicks it towards short leg who gets a hand on to deflect it towards short mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, Vijay hangs back and pats it back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, very full and dug out towards mid off.
A bit short outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
First signs of spin as MEHEDI HASAN comes on to bowl.
Drinks break....
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Square leg drops back.
FOUR! CLASSY SHOT! Vijay is now motoring along smoothly. Short of a length around off, gets back and across to play a controlled pull towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Good length around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Dug in short on middle and leg, Vijay rocks back and pulls it imperiously down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.

Sloppy! Fuller ball outside off, Vijay pushes it towards extra cover as the mid off fielder goes to his left to make the stop. The batsmen get a single and a wayward throw at the keeper's end allows them to take the second as well.
Good length outside off, Vijay goes back to play the punchy drive but mistimes it towards cover.
FOUR! ELEGANT SHOT! Full ball on middle, he gets across to that one and wrists it away beautifully through mid-wicket. Sublime timing on the shot and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Pujara leans forward and leaves it alone to the keeper.
Pitched up around off, crisply driven back towards Sarkar.
Fullish outside off, gets the stride forward and blocks solidly.
Better ball, good length on fourth stump line with a hint of away movement, carefully left alone by Pujara.
Starts with a very full ball that is way outside off, easy leave for Pujara.
SOUMYA SARKAR comes on to bowl. Bangladesh don't have a third pacer and so he has to fill in as a support seamer.
Nicely works a full ball down to fine leg for a single.
Another length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.

EDGED, DOESN'T CARRY! Lovely outswinger from Rabbi and it forces the outside edge as Pujara pushes at it. The edge just falls short of the man at first slip who was a bit deep too. Could Rahim have gone for the catch himself? Well, maybe but either way, the chance is gone now. You can't keep the slips so deep in the sub-continent anyway.
Fuller and outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Good length on middle and leg, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
Good length on fourth stump line, defended firmly off the back foot towards cover.
Good length very wide outside off, Taskin is wasting the movement but getting his line wrong. These are easy leaves for any batsmen like Vijay and Pujara.
Good length well outside off, seaming away, Pujara lets it pass.
Length ball outside off, once again lovely shape on the outswinger for Taskin. The line is just a bit wide and so Pujara leaves it with ease.
Late away movement on the length ball as Pujara lets it pass.

FOUR! Not convincing from Vijay! Banged in short on middle, he goes for the pull but wasn't in control at all. The ball flew off his glove down the leg side. The fine leg fielder was quite square and so he got a boundary. Probing over from Rabbi ends.
Good length around off, blocked solidly towards cover.
Fullish on middle, lovely flick from Vijay but he has hit it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Shortish again on middle, Pujara is certainly not liking this length and he hops across to fend it with more control past short leg. Single taken.
That was close! Short of a length on middle, Pujara hangs back to fend but is rapped on the glove. Almost carried to the short leg fielder.
Vijay gets lucky! Fuller ball outside off, went hard on the drive and got a thick inside edge. No footwork also and he is lucky that the ball missed leg stump. Single to fine leg.
Good length around off, Vijay gets a leading edge as he looks to flick. A single taken to cover. Once again there was a slight hesitation in the running but they made it with ease eventually.
Very straight from Taskin and Pujara tucks it through backward square leg for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Pujara hangs back and steers it towards point.
MIX UP BUT SAFE! Fuller around off, Pujara looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover-point. He was down the pitch for a single but is sent back. Makes it back just in time.
Good length outside off, Pujara gets back and glides it towards gully.
Fullish on middle and off, Vijay wrists it away through mid on. Nicely timed but it won't reach the fence. The batsmen will take three though.
Length ball outside off, defends it well off the front foot.

FOUR! FINDS THE FENCE! Fuller ball outside off, width on offer and Pujara obliges with a square driv e through backward point. It did seem initially that it came off the outer half but he had it in control.
Back of a length around off, Vijay gets back on his toes to tap it gently to short cover for a sharp run.
Dug in short but way down the leg side, easy leave for Vijay.
Very full on middle, Pujara gets across and works it to the left of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Fuller outside off, Vijay bunts it firmly towards cover.
Length ball outside off, Vijay lifts his bat to let it pass.
Dug in short around off, 144 kph, well angled bumper and Vijay arches his back to evade it. Good cricket all round.

Nicely bowled! Short of a length around off, climbs on Pujara who hops across to block. Pings the glove and the ball gets past short leg for a single. In the end, the fact that he played with soft hands helped him survive but only just.
Fuller on off, Pujara blocks it off the inside half towards short mid-wicket.
Good length on middle, Pujara taps it towards short leg where the fielder stops it.
Back of a length around off, Pujara rides the bounce to steer it towards point.
Once again the line is too wide outside off, Vijay comfortably lets it pass.
Length ball well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, Vijay eases it through cover-point. Finds the gap and gets a couple to go off the mark.
Length ball way outside off, Vijay leaves it alone to the keeper.
Strays well down the leg side, Vijay doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Good length around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Back of a length around off, Pujara gets right behind the line of that one and blocks.
Very full and on middle, Pujara shuffles and clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.

What happened there? Unwanted appeal from Bangladesh. This was a length ball well down the leg side, Pujara wanted to flick but decided not to play the shot. Rahim collected the ball with a full stretch dive to his left and all the players went up for an appeal. Not sure what the fuss was about, there was daylight between bat and ball. They almost went for the review there, it would have been hilarious had that happened.

Short of a length on middle, tucks up Pujara a bit as he taps it towards short leg. Looked a bit hurried on that occasion. He generally does look uncomfortable against the rising ball that is angled into his body.
Fuller outside off, Pujara gets a big stride forward and blocks it solidly.
Good length outside off, probing line and length, left alone.
Good length around off, Vijay gets back to drive but gets an inside edge to the leg side. Maiden from Rabbi.
Length ball on middle and leg, gets across and clips it towards the leg side.
Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot solidly.
Fuller outside off, defends it well.
This time Rabbi spears it well outside off, easy leave for the opener.
Fuller ball outside off, a hint of shape away as Vijay lets it pass.
KAMRUL ISLAM RABBI to share the new ball.
Full and outside off, solidly blocked this time from Pujara.
Almost another! Full and on the stumps, Pujara blocks it from the inside half of the blade.
CHETESHWAR PUJARA is the new man in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! What a start for Bangladesh to the Test match! Rahul will consider himself slightly unlucky but it wasn't a wise shot to start with. Full ball outside off, he goes for the lazy drive without any footwork. Gets a thick inside edge that cannons on to his back leg before disturbing the stumps. Taskin is pumped up and why shouldn't he be? Perfect start for the tourists.
Back of a length outside off, a bit of extra bounce this time but the line isn't threatening as Rahul lets it pass.
Length ball outside off, a bit too wide to make Rahul play.
Taskin starts with a loosener, full ball on the pads and Rahul gleefully tucks it through backward square leg for a couple.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle after the National Anthems of the two teams. KL RAHUL and MURALI VIJAY to open the batting for India. It shall be TASKIN AHMED to take the new ball. Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go!

MUSHFIQUR RAHIM hopes that his boys are pumped up as they are playing a top side in their den. Says that they learnt a lot of lessons from their recent New Zealand tour and stresses on the importance of playing consistent cricket over five days. Feels that it is a good pitch with some initial help for the pacers in the first hour. States that they are playing two pacers and two spinners with Shakib Al Hasan as the all-rounder.

VIRAT KOHLI says that India will bat first. Opines that it is a good pitch to bat on with a nice covering of grass. States that Hyderabad has always been a good pitch with some help for the quicks. Hopes that India can continue their Test match form without being complacent. AJINKYA RAHANE and BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR are back while WRIDDHIMAN SAHA to returns to the XI. India are playing three seamers and two spinners.
Time for the toss. Virat Kohli flips the coin, heads is the call from Mushfiqur Rahim and it is a tail. INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

Sunil Gavaskar says that there is an even covering of grass on the pitch which should allow the pitch to settle nicely. Batsmen should enjoy the surface although the cracks will gradually open up as the game progresses. Still, the deterioration should not be alarming enough.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the one-off Test match between India and Bangladesh in Hyderabad. There is a lot hype around this match due to the the tourists playing their first ever Test on Indian soil. They have their task cut out against the Numero Uno side who are in supreme form at the moment. Bangladesh's ability to play spin well will give them a better chance than the previous visiting sides but a lot hinges on their batting. India have a problem of plenty with their XI and it remains to be seen as to who all make the cut for the game. The toss and other updates are coming up shortly.
